summary.text: David Willis is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 68 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small business owner and a former Bank of America senior vice president.

paragraphs.text: Willis lives in Marvin, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree in marketing and business administration/management from Appalachian State University in 1996.
His career has included working as a senior vice president of Bank of America and owning Kiddie Academy of Charlotte-Blakeney.
Willis assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2021, succeeding D. Craig Horn.
The General Assembly's website lists him as a member of Union County's delegation in his third House term, with occupation small business owner.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Alcoholic Beverage Control and Appropriations committees and chair of the Appropriations on Education, Education - K-12, and House Select Committee on Blockchain and Digital Assets committees.
